## Attendance (presentation week)

Attendance is expected both days. Missing a presentation session carries a 15-point penalty on the presentation component of the project grade. Plan to attend both days, not only your own slot. The final wording of the penalty will be in the project guidelines.

The brief will say what data you may use, what you turn in at the checkpoint, and how the presentation is graded. See the [syllabus](../syllabus.qmd) and the [schedule](../schedule.qmd).
